introduction: A complete hands-on will provide students a complete understanding of all these concepts of plant metabolic. Visualization will help them see the experimental results under different environments and conditions. Students will be able to play with the options to get more insights about these concepts. After these virtual lab experiments, students will be able to do experiments in real lab and will also be equipped to handle and realize many practical communication systems.

experiments.name: Virtual experiments to study characteristics of plant cells and genomes
Gene isolation and characterisation, gene expression, gene regulation in plants
Genetic transformation techniques- Gene gun mediated, Agrobacterium mediated transformation - Overexpression, antisense expression (in model as well as crop plants)
Gene stacking- Improved trait introduction into local cultivars
Metabolic flux determination, pathway engineering in plants

objective: To provide students hands-on experience and basic understanding of key concepts of Plant Metabolic Engineering.

universities: All colleges offering programs that have B.Tech Biotechnology, Metabolic Engineering; Courses on Plant Biology, Plant Genetic Engineering.
